output_device.description: Target block device or 'usb' keyword for automatic USB detection.

boot_sectors.description: Mapping of filesystem types to boot sector binary files. If a type is missing, that FAT variant is not created.

boot_default.description: Default boot sector file to use if specific FAT type sector is not defined in boot_sectors.

mbr_file.description: Path to the Master Boot Record binary file. Empty string implies no MBR/floppy style.

mbr_fat.description: Set to true to enable MBR FAT compatibility mode (-F).

files.description: List of files to copy to the disk root with custom destination names.

files.items.source.description: Path to the source file on the host system.

files.items.dest.description: Filename to use on the FAT disk.

excludes.description: List of paths relative to the image directory to exclude during copy.

syslinux_version.description: Syslinux compatibility mode. '2' for syslinux 2.xx (-X), '3' for syslinux 3.xx (-Y). Empty for none.

zip_compat.description: Set to true to enable ZIP-Disk compatibility mode (-Z).

partition_mode.description: Set to true to force operation on a partition (-P).

bios_drive.description: BIOS drive number to embed in boot sector. 255 for auto-detection.

image_directory.description: Directory containing files to be copied to the bootable disk.
